digest.component_or_area: external live-service test harness / Jira Data Center integration
propositions: The Atlassian SDK's atlas-run downloads Jira 8.17.1 at container runtime from maven.atlassian.com, creating a hard network egress dependency that is not pinned by the base image digest alone.

A vendored Dockerfile must build locally from the addono/jira-software-standalone base pinned by digest, include -DskipAllPrompts=true and -Dproduct.start.timeout to prevent Marketplace v1 endpoint failures and Cargo deploy-timeout kills, and never be pulled from an external registry.

The harness must bind loopback-only (127.0.0.1:2990:2990 not 0.0.0.0) with tty/stdin_open flags, run only on native linux/amd64 runners to avoid emulation slowness exceeding startup timeouts, and mount a persistent Maven cache volume to avoid re-downloading ~900 artifacts on every start.

Smoke tests must prove Personal Access Token bearer authentication works against real Jira 8.17.1 via POST /rest/pat/latest/tokens, and that created issues are discoverable via REST v2 semantics (wiki markup not ADF, plain string descriptions not rich-text), proving DC rather than Cloud.
Teardown verification must poll each created issue's direct /rest/api/2/issue/{key} endpoint until 404 is returned, never consulting the search index, per ADR 0037 to avoid index lag artifacts.

The test suite must define module-level _live_jira_ready to participate in tests/external/conftest.py's all-skip canary guard, skip cleanly when the harness is absent (naming both make jira-dc-up and REBAR_RUN_EXTERNAL=1), and auto-apply the external marker without per-file decorators via conftest structural enforcement.
